records.title: Punching Above Their Weight: Classification-Head Fine-Tuning of Tiny Language Models (TLMs) for Verifiable Multiple-Choice Tasks
records.reason: The work evaluates fine-tuning paradigms for multiple-choice task quality; it is training-focused and reports no inference-efficiency contribution.

records.title: LLT: Local Linear Transformer for PDE Operator Learning
records.reason: LLT targets PDE neural-operator learning and reports training-iteration efficiency, not language-model inference/serving.

records.title: Towards Self-Evolving Agents: A Human-Inspired Adaptive Exploration-Exploitation Framework for Genetic Network Programming
records.reason: HGNP is an evolutionary agent-programming method evaluated on Tileworld; it is not LLM inference/serving work.

records.title: Cloud-Native Evaluation-as-a-Service: A Microservices Architecture for Scalable AI Monitoring with Conformal Guarantees
records.reason: EaaS is a platform for AI evaluation and monitoring; its microservice latency is for monitoring services, not LLM inference or serving efficiency.
